proposed_widenings.name: vehicle_or_controlled_object_mechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's main behavior is not a passive grant or a one-shot activation. It creates a persistent controllable object with its own object stats, occupancy, sealed-compartment state, movement modes, and lever-operated commands that change later behavior.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The Apparatus of the Crab is a Large object with the following statistics: AC 20; HP 200; Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft. ... A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down.

proposed_widenings.name: lever_state_and_command_table
proposed_widenings.justification: The lever table is durable item-owned state. Individual controls toggle shutters, claws, locomotion availability, lighting, hatch state, and attack modes. Those are not expressible as a flat grants list or a single activation phase sequence.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Ten levers are set in a row ... After each use, a lever goes back to its neutral position. Each lever, from left to right, functions as shown in the Apparatus of the Crab Levers table.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because any current encoding would be misleading. The existing magic-item families cannot honestly represent a persistent controllable vehicle/object with object statistics, occupants, airtight air-supply tracking, depth-pressure damage, and lever-driven mode changes.
